Name: Coldstream Turbines
Description:
Wind turbines for electric vehicles
The EV (electric vehicle) market is steadily on the rise. Not just in our own latitudes, but all across the wider world. This is partly due to economic factors which have made it easier for the average motorist to make greener choices. Moreover, the technology behind electric vehicles has gotten better and now offers more drive time per charge. Yet the range of electric vehicles remains a limiting factor, and that’s precisely where we come in.

Innovation that services the EV market in a whole new way
In order to service the market as best possible, our specialist teams are currently working to develop wind turbines for use in electric vehicles. The underlying technology is extensive and ensures a capacity for considerably longer drive time without compromising on the environment or price.  

We have taken the best of our knowledge and capabilities from the renewable energies market and transformed it into a high-tech solution which can create entirely new and improved conditions for the EV market, car manufacturers and the average motorist who wants to play their part in making the world a greener place.  

We expect to be able to send our first wind turbines into the market in 2021.

Description:
About Nilan - Manufacture of HVAC solutions for low energy buildings

Nilan develops and manufactures premium-quality, energy-saving ventilation and heat pump solutions that are beneficial to the environment and provide a healthy indoor climate and low-level energy consumption.

Since the company was founded in Denmark in 1974, Nilan’s activities have spread steadily to international markets. Today, the market has recognised our skills and approved our products. We are now represented across most of Europe and continue to expand.

We have always maintained a sharp focus on being at the cutting edge of the technological development in order to produce some of the market’s most efficient energy-saving ventilation systems and heat pumps.

Nilan’s initial steps were made in an endeavour to meet a need emerging from developments in the construction sector during the oil crisis. The crisis meant that people started to insulate buildings in order to save energy. This in turn meant that there was a need for solutions that would provide healthy indoor climate in these airtight buildings – a need Nilan was able to meet.

That’s how things were back then – and still are today: Our solutions are solutions for the future. They reduce your energy consumption and therefore preserve the environment. At the same time, our solutions are based on some of the world’s most advanced technologies.

Name: Windar Photonics A/S
Description:
Windar Photonics is a spin-off company from the Danish Technical University (DTU) at Risø, founded in 2008 and registered at the AIM, London Stock Exchange in 2015. Windar Photonics has its main office in Denmark and representative offices in China, along with sales representation and installation support for the North American and European markets 

Windar Photonics’ LiDAR assisted solutions offers asset owners the ability to both optimise and monitor their wind turbine generators, resulting in increased energy production, reduced loads, a wealth of wind field data, and accurate performance tracking of individual turbines and entire fleets.

OPTIMISATION SOLUTION
The Windar Photonics Optimisation solution enables asset owners to 
• Increase annual energy production (AEP) by 2-4%
• Decrease loads at high wind speeds

The Optimisation solution can be installed and integrated with the control system of any model of wind turbine and is delivered with the cyber-safe Nexus OS software platform.

The Windar Photonics Optimisation solution consists of the following products:
• The WindEYE LiDAR sensor
• The WindTIMIZER integration solution
• The Nexus OS software platform

MONITORING SOLUTION
The key component of the Monitoring solution is the Nexus TPM module, which is a software add-on for the Windar Optimisation solution.

The Nexus TPM provides an unbiased set of extremely accurate data relating to the performance of individual wind turbines, the performance of the entire fleet, and the wind field, enabling asset owners to both assess wind turbine performance and formulate data-driven optimisation strategies for enhancing the performance of entire wind farms.

• Unique solution for precisely monitoring wind turbine performance independently from other data sources
• Monitoring of wind turbine efficiency within ± 0.5% accuracy
• Enables monitoring of both single turbines and entire fleets

For more information: visit our website @ www.windarphotonics.com
Location: Ishøj, Capital Region Of Denmark, Denmark

Name: MadoquaPower2X
Description: MadoquaPower2X will use renewable energy and 500 MW of electrolysis capacity to produce annually 50,000 tons of green hydrogen and 500,000 tons of green ammonia at large scale. It is the first project to be installed at the future energy and technological hub of Sines with an industrial scale. MadoquaPower2X is a consortium comprised of Madoqua Renewables, Power2X and Copenhagen Infrastructure Partners (CIP). The consortium is committed to develop, install and operate the project to the highest environmental and safety standards. The project will be located in Portugal in the Sines industrial zone – ZILS – and it will generate economic growth with an economic activity classified as sustainable according to the latest EU Taxonomy and is an important factor to secure an independent power infrastructure.

Name: Lun
Description: Decarbonising homes. Faster.

Name: Connected Wind Services Group
Description:
Connected Wind Services is Europe’s strongest independent service provider for wind turbines. For more than 25 years, our multi-brand, multi-skill approach, combined with local competencies, has been the foundation for providing wind turbine operators and owners with unrivalled reliability and service.

We adapt to individual needs and are focused on the full lifecycle of wind turbines. Our reputation is built on efficiency, flexibility and safety within wind turbine Service Maintenance, Service Projects and retail of Components & Spare Parts. We deliver integrated, high-value services that help maximize yield and protect assets - providing all you need from a single point of contact.

Name: Svendborg Brakes
Description: Svendborg Brakes, Part of Regal Rexnord, is the innovator of industrial brake configurations and pioneers within hydraulic braking systems, power transmission and motion control products. Svendborg Brakes’ product range comprises hydraulic brakes and power units, braking controls and couplings to segments such as renewable energy, mining, cranes and oil & gas.

Name: VisBlue
Description:
VisBlue brings green energy technologies to market that offer stability and security to you and the grid as we transition to renewable energy sources.
This is what drives our team and where our strength lies. Through our work, we contribute to our shared vision of a world in balance. 

All our batteries use the sustainable vanadium redox flow technology to store energy respectively from renewable energy sources and/or the grid in a liquid that consists of 85% water with added sulfuric acid and the mineral vanadium.

This is a battery type that not only contributes positively to the climate, but also has a significantly lower impact on the environment and people than the more conventional battery types on the market.

Due to the technology's non-degradable, non-flammable and low-risk features, we can offer you a battery that delivers on all three bottom-lines of ESG, that being Environment, Social and Governance.

Name: Engineered Market Solutions ApS
Description:
Welcome to EMS, your trusted partner in overcoming challenges within the world’s most essential industries. As a strong Danish EPCI partner with a global footprint and extensive experience, we bring your plans to life through the expertise of our skilled engineers and craftsmen. Count on our world-class service department to keep your operations running seamlessly.

Established in 2009, EMS has evolved into an international supplier and sub-supplier of services to the energy industry. Committed to innovation, flexibility, and cost-effectiveness, we provide a wide array of inspection, installation, repair, and maintenance services, along with engineering, product management, manpower, machine shop, and fabrication competencies. We believe in fostering strong partnerships and relations with customers, business partners, and stakeholders. Our focus on fully understanding customer issues allows us to create tailored conceptual solutions that are cost-efficient and meet individual needs.

Our dedicated team, with years of experience in engineering, design, project management, fabrication, and maintenance, stands ready to tackle your unique visions and ideas. Equipped with state-of-the-art facilities, including cranes with high lifting capacities, we offer a comprehensive range of services both offshore and onshore. Whether working directly under your management or taking charge of entire projects, our competent and skilled employees are adaptable to your needs.

Name: Gram & Juhl
Description:
In 1997, Klaus Gram-Hansen and Axel Juhl founded their company Gram & Juhl — and developed the condition monitoring system know as TCM (Turbine Condition Monitoring). 

With TCM, Gram & Juhl became a leading supplier of condition monitoring solutions to the wind power industry, delivering advanced diagnostic capabilities. KK Wind Solutions acquired Gram & Juhl in October 2020.

TCM continues to expand its capabilities to empower owners and operators to predict turbine health and improve operational decisions that help reduce turbine downtime and increase power production.

Today, TCM is at the heart of a powerful suite of digital solutions within monitoring and prognostics offered by KK Wind Solutions.

For more information, visit tcm.kkwindsolutions.com

Name: ConWX
Description:
ConWX is a leading global forecasting provider with more than 15 years of experience in advanced weather and energy forecasting. Our mission is to help our customers optimize performance and grow their businesses with the highest accuracy and quality in power and weather forecasting. We do not believe in standard solutions; instead, we believe that through close collaboration with our business partners, we are able to find the best solution to their needs and situation

To date, we have forecasted more than 50,000 facilities in +50 countries with an installed capacity of +140 GW of wind and solar. 

Our core expertise includes: 
•	Wind power forecasts
•	Solar power forecasts 
•	Portfolio Analysis - simulating hourly production from wind & PV assets
•	Metocean forecasts
•	Historical weather data
•	Waiting on weather analysis (WoW)
•	Site assessment 
•	Numerical Weather Prediction Data
•	Long-term weather outlook 
•	Energy briefings

Name: ISOPLUS Group
Description:
The ISOPLUS group is the leading manufacturer and supplier of pre-insulated pipe systems, primarily for local and district energy supply. Founded in 1989, ISOPLUS has grown steadily over the past decades. Today, we produce pipes and accessories at the highest technical level in eight plants spread across Europe and sell them in more than 30 countries.
Decentralized production and organizational structures enable proximity to customers and thus also consider a more sustainable approach in the entire supply chain. Production follows innovative manufacturing methods, and our production facilities are of the latest standard. 
To guarantee and prove this long term, a consistent quality assurance applies. All ISOPLUS production plants are certified according to DIN EN ISO 9001. In addition, we have several environmental certificates according to DIN EN ISO 14001.
Over 1,500 employees of the Europe-wide ISOPLUS Group contribute to the implementation of the energy transition as suppliers to the energy supply and pipe service construction industries.

Name: PP Techniq A/S
Description:
“Flexible blade access” is our guiding star, and PP Techniq transforms service and maintenance of a wind turbine blade into a very different, much simpler process than ever before. Our platform can follow the shape and contours of the blade, which allows for a more efficient process for the blade technicians.

Leading Edge Protection
The platform provides access to the whole blade from root to tip, which ensures that technicians can perform maintenance work anywhere on the blade.

Thanks to the special design, easy access to the blade and perfect stability, PP Techniq platforms ensure optimal efficiency in blade maintenance and reduce downtime on the turbine to the absolute minimum. Maintenance has never been easier!

Blade Access - Platforms | Training | Service | Accessories

Name: Danish Bio Commodities (DBC)
Description:
Danish Bio Commodities arbejder for at skabe bedre vilkår for danske biogasanlæg. Vi varetager salg af grønne certifikater og hjælper biogasproducenter med at optimere værdien af deres produktion, til gavn for samfundet og ejerne. Det gør vi via professionel rådgivning, en effektiv certificeringsproces og adgang til et stærkt netværk af europæiske købere.
Siden vores start har vi udvidet forretningen markant og skabt et samlet setup, der dækker flere led i værdikæden. I dag ejer DBC både rådgivningsvirksomheden Nordic Green Engineering (NGE), som rådgiver omkring den grønne omstilling, herunder certificering af biogas i særdeleshed og BioCarb, som bringer den biogene CO2 fra nordeuropæiske biogasanlæg i anvendelse. Det betyder, at vi kan tilbyde vores samarbejdspartnere en komplet og smidig løsning – fra dokumentation og sporbarhed til strategisk sparring og markedsadgang.
Markedet for grønne certifikater udvikler sig hurtigt og bliver stadig mere komplekst – bl.a. pga. ny regulering og øgede krav til bæredygtighed. Derfor er det vigtigere end nogensinde at have en partner, der forstår både markedet og hverdagen ude på anlæggene.

DBC er etableret i partnerskab mellem Vestjyllands Andel, Jysk Energi, Dalgas og Langfristet Erhvervsfinansiering A/S.

Name: SaltPower
Description:
SaltPower is an innovative clean energy company. 

SaltPower presents an alternative to fossil fuels; one that is viable and sustainable at the same time, and which does not emit greenhouse gases. An energy source that is independent on whether the sun is shining, or the wind is blowing. 

We have further developed and commercialized the concept of using osmotic power to produce electricity. We build scalable systems that harness the osmotic energy locked away in saltwater.

Name: LORC
Description:
Lindø Offshore Renewables Center (LORC) is one of the leading test centers for wind power technology supporting the green transition with state-of-the-art test facilities and infrastructure. 

LORC is a private and independent provider of test and validation services founded in 2009.  
 
LORC operates without profit as an objective.  
 
Our aim is to support the sector for renewable energy by improving product reliability and thereby reducing the levelized cost of renewable energy. 

LORC’s testing activities includes facilities for i) functional, ii) electrical and iii) highly accelerated lifetime test of wind turbine nacelles and drive trains, iv) for main and blade bearing testing, v) for fatigue testing of large structures, vi) for climatic testing of large components and systems and vii) test and demonstration facilities for industry scale battery energy storage systems (BESS). 

LORC’s nacelle and drive train test facilities constitutes some of the words most powerful facilities including our 14MW facility with a 21MW Grid emulator for functional and grid compliance testing, and our 16MW and 25MW facilities for highly accelerated lifetime tests. 

LORC’s bearing test facilities constitute some of the words most powerful facilities for testing of wind turbine bearings including our main bearing test facility and our blade bearing test facility for off-shore wind turbines. 

The facilities for component and structure testing are organized in the subsidiary company “Lindø Component and Structure Testing (LCST)” co-owned with FORCE Technology.  
 
The company hosts an outdoor strong floor for fatigue testing of large structures, and one of Europe’s largest climatic chambers for exposing components and systems to extreme climatic conditions. 

Visit the world’s largest test center for making renewable energy viable at www.lorc.dk

Name: Aalborg Renewables
Description: Aalborg Renewables is a community for businesses within the on- and off-shore wind energy industries in Northern Denmark. The community is open to all businesses and organizations wishing to contribute know-how and engagement with a commercial mindset.

Name: GH Sustainability
Description:
GH Sustainability provides innovative results worldwide in the areas of Sustainable Solutions, Climate Change, and Energy & Environment.  We provide smart and practical solutions for businesses, local communities, governments, and multilateral institutions towards meeting higher standards for sustainability in their development and operations.  This includes actively supporting public and private organizations in addressing sustainable actions and transformational change in all levels of their operation.  Further to this, we support governments and businesses in the planning and implementation of actions to mitigate GHG emissions and adapt to climate change (increase resilience).  We also provide a range of technical and economic services to address aspects for the planning, design, and implementation of renewable energy & environmental technologies. 

The history of GH Sustainability goes back to the period of 1998 to 2002 where Grue & Hornstrup addressed renewable energy and environmental projects in four Eastern European countries.  These activities expanded, and between 2003 and 2018 the Energy & Environment Group of Grue & Hornstrup had provided solutions in climate change, renewable energy, and environmental technology in over 35 countries worldwide.  Whereby in 2018 the worldwide activities of the Energy & Environment Group were placed under the associated company GH Sustainability.

Name: DaCES – Dansk Center for Energilagring
Description:
Dansk Center for Energilagring er et partnerskab som dækker hele værdikæden fra forskning og innovation til industri og eksport indenfor energilagring og -konvertering.

Dansk Center for Energilagring (DaCES) vil styrke samarbejde, vidensdeling og etablering af nye partnerskaber mellem virksomheder og universiteter. Centeret vil dermed sikre en langsigtet, fokuseret og koordineret indsats mellem alle relevante aktører indenfor områder som termisk lagring, batteriteknologi, systemintegration og Power to X.

Name: Quantafuel Skive
Description:
Quantafuel Skive produces environmentally friendly, clean and low-cost synthetic fuel by recycling plastic waste, including food packaging and stretching film from agriculture. Through a unique and efficient pyrolysis process, the plastic is converted to fuel, diesel and petrol (PtL). The technology has been developed by Quantafuel AS, a Norwegian technology-driven energy company.
Quantafuel Skive is in the area, GreenLab Skive, north of Skive City in Denmark.

Name: WPU - Waste Plastic Upcycling A/S
Description:
We transform plastic waste into new "green" oil which can be used to produce new plastic or to make climate friendly fuel. We believe it makes sense to use old plastic to drive, sail or fly! 

The journey of plastic from waste to new plastic takes place in the reactors at WPU's factories. The technology is based on pyrolysis which processes the plastic at high temperatures. The process returns plastic-oil that can be used for new plastics or as additives to petrol and diesel and thus replace the bio-oils that are grown on our agricultural land today.

WPU is in rapid development. We are in the process of building three factories, and the first factory will be ready in 2022. From 2024 our factories can recycle 159,000 tonnes of plastic waste annually.

Name: Pronamic
Description:
Pronamic was founded in 1984 and has through these 42 years delivered more than 400.000 rain gauges worldwide.
Pronamic was in a very early stage in a process of internationalization and has established export to more than 70 countries on 6 continents.

In January 2021 a change in the ownership was completed, in order to make Pronamic ready for the future challenges on the global market. The present owner are Søren Kjær Ostersen.

It has always been Pronamics policy to deliver to OEM manufacturers only. It is important for us, that we shall not compete with our customers on the end user market.

Today Pronamic has a broad product range, but the DNA of the products is still our unique patented self-emptying tipping bucket. New products are constantly developed around our tipping bucket principal.

It is our goal to be the best and most reliable business partner in the market for rain gauges. It shall be easy and comfortable for our customers to work with Pronamic.

Name: Danish Wind Design
Description:
Design of wind turbines
Wind turbine technology

Name: Vaillant A/S
Description:
Vaillant Group is an internationally operating heating, ventilation and air-conditioning technology concern based in Remscheid, Germany. As one of the world's market and technology leaders, the company develops and produces tailor-made products, systems and services for domestic comfort. The product portfolio ranges from efficient heating appliances based on customary fuels to system solutions for using regenerative energy sources. In financial year 2007 the company, which has been family-owned since its founding in 1874, achieved with almost 12,400 employees sales totalling about €2.4 billion. 

At 16 production or R&D locations in seven European countries and in China, we develop and manufacture heating, ventilation and air-conditioning technology products for sale in Europe and Asia.

Name: Modstrøm Danmark A/S
Description:
Modstrøm er Danmarks førende grønne energiselskab.
Vores mission er at drive danskernes grønne energiomstilling ved at gøre
det nemt, økonomisk bæredygtigt og fordelagtigt at omstille sig til grøn energi med klimavenlige og innovative produkter og services.
Modstrøm vil bidrage til danskernes erkendelse af, at den grønne
energiomstilling ikke kun handler om at købe strøm fra grønne energikilder,
men om aktivt at gennemføre energiforbedringer i den enkelte husstand og
virksomhed med alt fra LED pærer og digitale termostater til varmepumper,
solcelleanlæg og ladestandere.

Vi viser vej og gør det nemt for private og virksomheder at handle på en grøn
holdning. Vi giver dig overblik over dine muligheder, og vi er totalleverandør af hele din personlige grønne omstilling.
Vi Modstrøm Danmark A/S er et selvstændigt elselskab, som sælger strøm til både privat- og erhvervskunder over hele Danmark. Modstrøm har eksisteret siden 2008 og har i dag mere end 80.000 kunder. Som Danmarks første uafhængige og klimavenlige energiselskab har vi banet vejen for et mere fleksibelt og konkurrencedygtigt elmarked til gavn for forbrugerne – og for klimaet. 

Hos Modstrøm arbejder vi for en bæredygtig fremtid med vores kunder som drivkraft. Vi tager aktiv del i deres forbrugsvaner og udvikler produkter, der motiverer vores kunder til at reducere deres energiforbrug og blive aktive forbrugere. Vi arbejder hver dag på at hjælpe danskerne med at bruge energien bedre.

Modstrøm er derfor mere end leverandør af energi. Vi er en aktiv sparringspartner, og vores energivejledere står altid klar til at rådgive både virksomheder og private forbrugere om energioptimering og energisparetips, ligesom vi hjælper vores kunder til at bruge af energi på det tidspunkt, hvor den er billigst og mest bæredygtig. 

Læs om vores tilbud og produkter på vores hjemmeside: www.modstroem.dk

Besøg Klimabutikken og køb energivenlige produkter: www.modstroem.dk/klimabutikken

Name: IRD Fuel Cells A/S
Description:
IRD Fuel Cells is a private company which provides quality and innovation for its customers based on the highest levels of integrity, environment and strong values.

At IRD Fuel Cells, we are devoted to the research, development, and production of fuel cell components; Developing top-quality fuel cells requires many years of experience and knowledge, as well as the expertise of a variety of specialists. We have been in the business since 1996, and our highly skilled team comprises people with many different backgrounds.

Our vision is to be acknowledged as the leading supplier of unlimited energy solutions of the future, and to play a significant role in powering people anywhere.

Name: SolarFuture ApS
Description:
SolarFuture er en højt specialiseret rådgivnings-, montage og driftsvirksomhed indenfor større anlæg af solceller til industri og erhverv i Danmark og Skandinavien.

Vi er specialister i totalløsninger af solcelleanlæg til industri og erhverv på over 250 kWp - som både kan anlægges på tag eller opsættes som markanlæg. 

SolarFuture er blandt de få virksomheder i Danmark, der kan levere totalentrepriser indenfor solcelleanlæg, hvor vi både bistår vores kunder med rådgivning og planlægning, montering og tilslutning, samt efterfølgende drift- og fejlovervågning. Vi råder over egne specialister der kan rådgive om såvel rentabilitet ift. energipriser og tekniske muligheder vedr. planlægningen. Vi har desuden vores egne byggeledere der leder montageprocessen i samarbejde med en fast underentreprenør, der er blandt Europas bedste montører, med international erfaring fra projekter meget større end vi ser i Danmark.

SolarFuture tilbyder desuden IT-overvågning og fejlfinding af anlæg som sikrer en fejlfri levering af strøm de næste mange år.

Kontakt gerne en af vores projektledere hvis du vil vide mere om vores løsninger og hvordan vi kan hjælpe jer igang med at producere egen CO2-fri strøm.

Name: Dansk Solcelleforening
Description: Dansk Solcelleforenings formål er at understøtte og fremme solcelleaktiviteter i Danmark - til gavn for os alle.

Name: DVI Energi A/S
Description:
Siden 1979 har DVI Energi udviklet, designet og produceret varmepumpeløsninger i Danmark.

Vi leverer energieffektive varmepumpeløsninger i høj kvalitet til private boligejere såvel som virksomheder og institutioner. Vores løsninger anvendes både i nybyggeri og ved energirenovering af eksisterende varmeanlæg.  

Med fokus på dansk håndværk, driftssikkerhed og innovation skaber vi løsninger, der er udviklet til nordiske forhold og bidrager til en mere energieffektiv fremtid.

Name: HelloScience
Description: We want to partner with anyone who shares our ambition and passion for technology. By sharing our expertise, technology, and resources, our ambition is to develop ideas into sustainable solutions, together with you.

Name: Combigas - Complete biogas solutions
Description:
Combigas is an experienced and dynamic Danish company whose core business is to develop, design, implement and support complete biogas solutions.

Biogas technology converts a passive waste material into clean and sustainable energy. The Biogas plants are developed with respect for nature and the people who operate them.

The plants are built by professional contractors in close cooperation with
Combigas employees who monitors the project throughout the entire process.
Combigas want to ensure access to affordable, reliable and sustainable green
energy for everyone.

Name: ENERGRID
Description:
Vi er eksperter i nettilslutning af vedvarende energi, og vi kan bistå jeres projekt - før og under udbudsperioden samt ved nettilslutning. Efterfølgende kan vi være behjælpelige med driften.

Læs mere om ENERGRID på energrid.dk
Kontakt os på tlf. 96 70 22 20.

Name: NorSea Wind
Description:
NSG Wind provides integrated logistics and technical solutions for the planning, construction, operation and maintenance for offshore projects. With its vast experience in effective technical management of offshore assets, it is our objective to deliver one interface for our customers for all services rendered from several companies, each expert in their field of work. NSG Wind was established in 2016 as NorSea Group’s integrated project service provider to offshore wind industry. 
NorSea Group is a multi service provider and Norway’s leading supplier of base and logistics services to the offshore industry, with more than 50 years of experience. NorSea Group, owned by the leading maritime group, Wilhelmsen, and the two shipping companies, Møkster and Eidesvik.

Name: WattsUp Power A/S
Description:
WattsUp Power offers a cutting edge energy storage solution, based on flywheel technology. Flywheel technology is the only high density and low loss energy storage system in the world today with a 100% green footprint. No exotic metals and no chemicals are used to store the energy, which is required from our customers whether it is a standalone alternative energy storage or power infrastructure enhancement. 
 
The energy storage technology has been developed together with leading global power utilities and WattsUp Power has today a product range of energy storage devices designed to be installed directly into electrical grid infrastructure or directly at the customers premises. WattsUp Power offers a 30kWh or a 100kWh solution with power grid connectivity and with a special option of fast charging electrical vehicles.

Name: Skagen SSB
Description:
Skagen SSB was established in 1984 with a keen focus on the marine industry. Today we handle maintenance and repairs of both bridges, power plants, steel components for wind turbines and wind turbine rotor blades.

Skagen Sandblæseri & Skibsservice is a family owned business founded by Ole Conradsen in Skagen, Denmark. In 1988, we moved the head office 40 km south to Frederikshavn, where the company entered into cooperation with Ørskov Stålskibsværft A/S, and that is still where you’ll find us. The name Skagen has been around for all the years, and today it is a reminder of where it all started.

Name: CIRCit - Circular Economy Integration in the Nordic Industry
Description:
Join the Nordic Cooperation’s CIRCit project and discover the opportunities to transform your business model, product development and business operations. Be part of the community that is already closing their product and business loops and gaining great sustainability and market-share benefits!

The CIRCit project is a Nordic research project aiming at industrial transition towards circular economy, and includes experienced research partners from all five Nordic countries. The project started in spring 2017 and will continue until summer 2020.

Consortium
DTU Mechanical Engineering
Technology Industries of Finland
Innovation Center Iceland (ICI)
NTNU Department of Computer Science
RISE IVF (former Swerea IVF) Energy and Environment

Name: HybridGenerator ApS
Description: Since 2010 we have been passionate about producing and delivering cost-effective and environmentally friendly hybrid generators with a long operational life. It is vital to us that we make a difference to our customers and that there are more advantages than disadvantages to switching to green energy. The cost-efficiency, user-friendliness, and reduced environment impact of our products are the essence of everything we do.

Name: Energi Innovation ApS
Description:
Energi Innovation ApS has strong proven track record in photovoltaic business, providing a full range package of project management; from development, financing, construction, storage/balancing, to trading as well as long term operation and maintenance.  

In 2017 Energi Innovation acquired and finalized development of the first large international project pipeline ‘Benfica’ - the first subsidy free PV projects in Portugal. Construction has been executed during 2018 and 2019, making Energi Innovation one of the largest companies in the photovoltaic business on the Iberian peninsula.

Name: Innovation Hub SUSTAIN - en del af DANDY Business Park
Description:
Vi samler al kommunikation på én side!

Hos DANDY Business Park har vi valgt at gøre det lettere for vores følgere at holde sig opdaterede. Derfor har vi nedlagt vores tre hubs: TECH, FOOD og SUSTAIN, og samlet al vores indhold på én platform – vores hovedside: DANDY Business Park.

Name: H2 Logic A/S
Description: H2 Logic A/S is a leading manufacturer of H2Station hydrogen refueling stations that provides fuel cell electric vehicles with the same fast fueling and long range as conventional vehicles today. Since incorporation in 2003 H2 Logic has invested significantly in R&D that has brought H2Station to a level where products are offered for the early market for roll-out of larger networks of hydrogen refueling stations. H2 Logic is part of NEL ASA listed on the Oslo Stock Market. NEL ASA is a leading global supplier of hydrogen technology for industrial / energy purposes, and has made over 500 deliveries in more than 50 countries.

Name: GreenHyScale H2020
Description:
READY, SET, SCALE! 
October 26th, 2021 marked the official kick-off of the GreenHyScale project with the purpose of exploring largescale production of green hydrogen in an industrial symbiosis setting. 
The project aims to accelerate pressurised alkaline electrolysis to enable large-scale production of green hydrogen, making the establishment of a commercially viable hydrogen infrastructure possible. The goal is a 100 MW electrolysis plant erected in GreenLab, Denmark, and replicable in the rest of the world. This is a cornerstone in the global green and “just” transition.

Name: Danish Cleantech Hub
Description:
Danish Cleantech Hub is a public-private partnership, led by the Confederation of Danish Industry and State of Green. We support the visibility and commercialization of green Danish city solutions in selected focus markets around the world.

Danish Cleantech Hub enables Danish cleantech companies to align their own business development efforts with a broader agenda on sustainable urban development.

Name: Waste-Outlet
Description:
NOTHING IS REALLY WASTE!

In our online trading portal you have easy access to new markets and a network of companies, and will save time and administration cost when trading waste and secondary raw materials.

Use our trading platform to: 
- Create broader demand and competition for your waste and recyclables
- Connect with new trading partners both nationally and internationally
- Save time and administration costs
- Get notifications when new materials that have your interest are listed
- Safeguard your trades with Escrow payment solution
- Etc.

For more information, please contact us at: +45 53 37 38 80, or visit our homepage at www.waste-outlet.com.

Name: Frichs Pyrolysis
Description:
Frichs Pyrolysis ApS is a small development company that works with a newly developed and patented pyrolysis technology and will deliver three plants in 2024.
We do carbon capture and storage with biomass and with energy surplus. This results in CO2 negative energy production.
We have developed a method and a reactor for pyrolysis treatment of virtually all hydrocarbon-containing material - including sewage sludge, synthetic materials, animal and vegetable biomass.
It is a new designed pyrolysis reactor.
A pyrolysis gas system has been developed which, via flash pyrolysis and with a newly developed reactor design, extractes a clean gas without tar and with a calorific value of 18-21, which therefore works perfectly in a CHP plant and a biochar with almost no PAH.
One must imagine the gas generator used on cars during World War II in a larger and newly developed design - but the basic principle is the same. The challenge during the war was, and has been ever since, that the calorific value has been at 3-5, and that tar fragments in the gas have caused engines to quickly to work bad because of soot - alternatively that the plants and processes developed have been unprofitable.
It is now resolved.

Name: RESTORE Project
Description:
RESTORE – Renewable Energy based seasonal Storage Technology in Order to Raise Economic and environmental sustainability of DHC – is a EU HORIZON 2020 project. The main objective of the RESTORE project is to develop a solution, based on the combination of two key innovative technologies, that allows integrating a wide variety of Renewable Energy Sources (RES) in District Heating and Cooling (DHC) networks. RESTORE provides efficient and innovative solutions for the decarbonisation of the heating and cooling needs, using an optimal integration of different renewable energies via an innovative thermochemical energy storage (TCES) combined with a heat pump (HP) and an Organic Rankine Cycle (ORC), paving the way towards the renewable-driven DHC transition and having a direct environmental impact on GHG emission, air pollutants and fossil fuel reduction. The innovative combination of a TCES and the HP/ORC technology makes it possible to overcome the intermittency among the supply of thermal energy and the fluctuating demand for heat or cold present in DHC networks, thus increasing the availability and reliability of energy distribution on the grid. The RESTORE project provides a clear break-through thermal energy storage technology for the decarbonisation of the district heating sector, enabling the use of RES, especially solar heat, and waste excess heat collected in summer for heating purposes in winter in a very competitive way. RESTORE started in October 2021 and will have a duration of 4 years.

Instead of burning the forestry waste in open cooking fires, rural households bring it to the Dazin Collection Points (CP). Description:
ATLA is developing a mobile application (dApp) giving access to a peer-to-peer network of renewable energy sharing that powers an out-of-the-box social network for small communities in order to help local municipalities and community members to map sustainable governmental directives (SDGs) and practices unto concrete local actions. Thus, bridging the intention to change underlying top-down policies and  directives to a local, actionable, community level.

ATLA does this by transforming locally self-produced renewable energy into a sustainable asset: A complementary energy- and economic resource for the ATLA community.

ATLAs Starting point is from increasing the utility and the value-generating potential of pre-installed residential PV Solar systems.

Hence, ATLA increases capacity of additions of R. E additions to meet the goals of the Paris agreement by 2030.  

Currently, residential PV solar systems are a costly investment with an unfavorable ROI for any generated energy surplus delivered back to the grid due to high transmission costs. Investment are currently heavily subsidized.

Renewables are further unutilized, unstored and consequently wasted during periods of oversupply in the grid. 

ATLAs ecosystem consists of three parts:

1. The ATLA Cloud; A Virtual platform for peer-to-peer (p2p) energy sharing and - circulation based on hybrid p2p technology and tokenization of Energy through the Ethereum smart-contract ecosystem.

2. The ATLA Social Networking Platform: a forum for action that enables sharing of any generated surplus of renewable energy to sustainable causes and entities in a community, albeit residents, businesses and institutions. Using tokenized energy as a reward for Sustainable Development oriented actions and related activities.

3. You, a willing participant. 

Now, we seize the opportunity to build a forum for action and to explore bottom-up incentivized measures. 

With this, we welcome for a common vision of a shared future.

Imdex A/S er en moderne innovativ Dansk genbrugsvirksomhed af End-of Life Tires (ELTs), Genbrugsideen med at recirkulere nedslidte bildæk til genbrug startede i efteråret 2001. I forbindelse med den første dækbekendtgørelse udarbejdet af Miljøstyrelsen, allerede i foråret 2002 indgik man en aftale med verdens største maskinproducent Danske Eldan om installation af en helt ny og moderne produktionslinje til neddeling af dæk. I Danmark har vi årligt ca. 44.000 tons nedslidte dæk (ELT), hvilket vil give et massivt affalds og miljøproblem såfremt vi ikke får dem genbrugt. De indgår nu i den cirkulære økonomi også kaldet vugge til vugge som er vejen til bæredygtigt genbrug.

Hos Imdex A/S neddeler vi dækkene (ELT) i forskellige størrelser som igen genanvendes til mange forskellige formål, fyld i kunstgræsbaner, faldunderlag, ridebaner og gummiindustrien til nye emner er blot nogle af genbrugsmulighederne der bliver brugt i dag. 
Genbrug af dæk er derfor den langt mest bæredygtige og miljøvenlige løsning på et ”problem” der ellers vil blive et meget stort affaldsproblem.

Hos Imdex A/S tænker personalet konstant i innovativ bæredygtigt genbrug af dækkene, hvilket i dag betyder at når dækket er nedbrudt i de tre fraktioner som dækkene består af - nemlig gummi, tekstil og stål, så har vi kun 1% affald og dermed 99% genbrug, med altid helt optimerende processer hjælper vi i dag miljøet med meget mindre CO2 udledning til gavn for vores miljø, kunderne og verdens lunger.

Description:

Name: First Offshore Wind Project of India (FOWPI)
Description:
The First Offshore Wind Project of India (FOWPI) is part of the “Clean Energy Cooperation with India" (CECI) programme, funded by the European Union (EU). The programme aims at enhancing India's capacity to deploy low carbon energy production and improve energy efficiency, thereby contributing to the mitigation of global climate change. Project activities will support India's efforts to secure the energy supply security, within a well-established framework for strategic energy cooperation between the EU and India.

FOWPI is defined as a conceptual offshore wind farm near the coast of Gujarat, 25 km off Jafarabad. The project scope focus is on preliminary investigations and advisory for the wind farm including wind turbine
foundation, electrical network, metocean modelling, wind study, environmental scoping, financial modelling and other relevant technical studies. FOWPI uses the outputs from Facilitating Offshore Wind in India
(FOWIND) project (2013-2018) also supported by the European Union. FOWIND and FOWPI bring the vast experience of European countries in offshore wind, to support India with the creation of a national knowledge centre and with technical support for setting up the first offshore wind-farms.

FOWPI is led by COWI A/S (Denmark) with support from COWI Pvt Ltd India and WindDForce Management Ltd. (India). The project is implemented in close collaboration with the European Union, the Ministry of New
and Renewable Energy- India (MNRE) and National Institute of Wind Energy- India (NIWE).

Name: Elysium Nordic
Description:
3 million end-of-life tires (ELT) are collected every year across the EU countries. But the way they are processed is far from optimal. Although most of ELT are recycled, one third are still incinerated for energy purposes. These ELT are treated as waste instead of the valuable resource they are.

The consequences of not recycling ELT are continued dependence on non-renewable resources such as oil and extensive CO2 emission to manufacture new tires. This  not only creates climate and environmental challenges, but it is also a poor economic model, as valuable materials from ELT tires are lost.

Many have been in search for economically viable alternatives to the incineration of ELT and Elysium Nordic will change this situation from 2021 by using the patented pyrolysis technology developed by Scandinavian Enviro Systems to recover from ELT materials such a gas, steel, oil and especially carbon black, which is a material that is irreplaceable in the production of tires and other rubber-based products.
The first pyrolysis plant will be built in the port of Nyborg in Denmark with the capacity to recover more than 9.000 tons of carbon black from 30.000 tons of ELT. The plant is the first important step towards a more circular, sustainable and reasonable approach to handling ELT.

Name: MSCA GECKO Innovation and Training Network
Description:
GECKO is a European Innovation and Training Network of European the Marie Skłodowska-Curie Action funding scheme. 

 GECKO researches accountable, responsible, and transparent artificial intelligence (ART AI) to address urgent environmental needs and achieve European Green Deal ambition, ensuring that all citizens benefit from the sustainable green transition. 

The project hosts 15 PhD candidates at 9 European research facilities and industry partners. bringing together the latest scientific advances, establishing a unique synergy between the social sciences, information sciences, and engineering. By designing AI from a user perspective, GECKO will prevent the limitation of current technologies where AI reasoning and outcomes could easily be harmful, emotionally offensive, and damaging to the wider society and economy.

- Reducing energy costs

At YES-Europe DK our aim is to actively facilitate the debate about the future of energy by organizing events in Denmark bringing students, academia and industry together to exchange ideas and share knowledge.

If this sounds like something you would like to be part of or are you just interested in joining one of our events, please get in touch with us!

Feel free to contact us through the email contact@yes-energy-europe.com

Name: HydroSystems ApS
Description:
HydroSystems is specialized in products for optimizing the sewer system. The company was founded in Denmark year 2004 and since then we have developed a range of highly specialized equipment on our own as well as we deliver a wide - high quality - product range from our German partners. 

The HydroSystems product range gives you:

-	Automatically treatment of Combined Sewer Overflow (CSO) in order to minimize the environmental impact on the recipients and avoid the cost and space for unnecessary large retention basins.
We developed the HydroSeparator CSO as a Best Management Practice.

-	Automatically treatment of Storm Water from polluted areas such as industry and roads before outlet to rivers and lakes etc. 
We developed the HydroSeparator as a Best Management Practice.

-	Automatically flushing the sewer system and retention basins
We are the leading company in delivering flushing systems for very large underground retention basins and tunnel pipes with a Hydraulic penstock.

-	Accurate and automated control of flow in sewer systems, both mechanical solutions and dynamic controlled solutions with PLC controlled panels and communication to central operator via SRO/SCADA systems.
We are using high precision flow regulators for optimal control of the water and flow.
 
In HydroSystems we cooperate closely with our sister company Bonnerup Consult - a highly specialized engineering company focusing on optimizing sewer systems and contributes for example with hydraulic calculations, risk maps and climate adaption to optimize and develop our solutions. 

Also we are cooperating with a number of Danish consulting engineering companies, and with our supply partners in Germany.

When doing business with HydroSystems you are always offered a solution we can be proud of - many of them preparing you for the climate changes.

Name: RegnvandsTanken.dk
Description:
Regnvandstanken.dk er skabt ud fra visionen om at anvende regnvand som en ressource på en bæredygtig måde, med salg til både private og erhverv

Vi har tre mål:
- at bidrage til at spare på en af de mest dyrebare ressourcer vi har, nemlig grundvand, naturens økosystem er vores alles ansvar.
- at hjælpe med at frakoble regnvand fra spildevandet for at undgå oversvømmelser af kloaker ved større regnskyl, det medfører altid forurening af naturen med spildevand
- at hjælpe private og virksomheder med at spare penge på vandregning og afledning af spildevand

Regnvand er en ressource der på nær konsum, kan anvendes til adskillige formål, toiletskyl, tøjvask, bilvask, havevanding, kun fantasien sætter grænser.

Vi kan rådgive dig om komplette anlæg til opsamling af regnvand eller enkelte dele af komplette anlæg.
Vores tyske samarbejdspartner er førende indenfor produktion af helstøbte plasttanke med enorm erfaring fra Tyskland hvor opsamling af regnvand er en naturlig ting i rigtig mange husholdninger og industrier,

Vores hjemmeside indeholder en række produkter og vi er lagerførende i dem alle. Skulle der være noget vi ikke har på lager, hvis du har specielle krav, så kan vi hurtigt skaffe det.
Og vi sender naturligvis til hele Danmark og Norden.

Vi er altid interesseret i at finde nye samarbejdspartnere, særligt salg og installation af vores produkter.

Name: Planet Happy
Description:
Bæredygtighed, teknologi og fremtid.

Planet Happy er en podcast, der udforsker netop de tre områder for at afdække, hvordan vi kan blive mere bæredygtige forbrugere. 

Hvis vi skal undgå at opvarme kloden mere end 2 grader inden 2050, har vi alle sammen virkelig travlt. Men hvor skal vi hen, og hvordan går vi den vej som samfund, virksomheder og forbrugere? Hvem har ansvaret, hvordan bærer vi ansvaret på vores skuldre, og hvordan kan vi bruge teknologien til at hjælpe os på vej?
